description: Shared object definitions for academic CV records. Date shapes and organisation-reference conventions deliberately mirror id.sifa.* so that records from both namespaces can be merged into one profile without translation.

organization.description: Reference to an institution, funder, publisher, or society. NEVER key on `name`: it is a display string that varies by language, era, and abbreviation. Identity comes from `ror` or `wikidata`. Mirrors the id.sifa.* entityRef convention.

name.description: Display name in the record's locale. Not an identifier.

ror.description: Bare ROR ID, e.g. '03vek6s52'. Preferred identifier for research organisations and funders.

wikidata.description: Wikidata Q-ID, e.g. 'Q13371'. Use when no ROR exists (companies, societies, prizes).

department.description: Faculty, department, or lab. Free text: departmental identifiers are not standardised.

personRef.description: Reference to another person -- an advisor, co-presenter, student, or co-recipient. PRIVACY: prefer `did` or `orcid`. Do not populate `name` for a person who has not consented to appearing in this account's public records. This matters most for students (see id.career.supervision).

name.description: Display name. Requires the person's consent when they are not a public co-author of a published work.

affiliation.description: Affiliation at the relevant time, not necessarily their current one.

scope.description: Geographic reach. Japanese 業績票 and many tenure files require 国際/国内 to be distinguished, so it is a first-class field rather than something inferred from the venue name.

fieldCode.description: Research field under a controlled vocabulary, so profiles are searchable across languages.

scheme.description: 'kakenhi' is the JSPS 審査区分 / 分科細目 table. 'researchmap' is researchmap's own hierarchical 研究分野 vocabulary, e.g. 'ものづくり技術（機械・電気電子・化学工学） / バイオ機能応用、バイオプロセス工学' -- stored as a scheme rather than free text because it is a controlled list that Japanese systems match on exactly.

money.description: A monetary amount. `value` is a decimal STRING, not a number: JSON floats lose precision on large yen figures and lexicon has no decimal type.

value.description: Decimal digits with optional '.', no thousands separators, e.g. '39000000'.

sectionSpec.description: One section of a rendered CV. `source` is an NSID string rather than an enum so a dossier can pull in records from namespaces this lexicon does not own -- notably id.sifa.profile.position for employment history.

source.description: Collection NSID to draw from, e.g. 'id.career.grant' or 'id.sifa.profile.position'.

title.description: Heading text in the dossier's locale, e.g. 'Publications' or '研究業績'.

sinceYear.description: Omit entries older than this. Common for 'selected publications' or 'last 5 years' funding sections.

includeTypes.description: Filter on the source record's `type`/`role` enum, e.g. only ['invited','keynote'] for a selected-talks section.

numbered.description: Render as a numbered list. Japanese 業績票 and tenure files usually require numbering.

reverseNumbering.description: Number from N down to 1, the common convention for reverse-chronological publication lists.
